CI run summary: **698 passed, 2 failed** out of 700 tests.

**Failures:**
1. `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — auth/tokens.test.js:400
2. `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — auth/tokens.test.js:650

Both failures are in the same file (`auth/tokens.test.js`) and both point to real auth/session-integrity bugs (not flaky timeouts or infra noise) — worth looking at before merging: one suggests revoked tokens can still be refreshed, the other suggests failed transactions leave orphaned session rows.
